messages:
Tara (AE): Heads-up — client (Cardinal Health) requested an assurance ZIP for the POC: SOC2 excerpt, ISO snapshot, signed pentest attestation (exec summary only), a 1-page control map to HIPAA ePHI, and a short Hosted vs Dedicated cost note. Need it in their dataroom by EOD tomorrow. Can we?
Noah (SE): I can pull SOC2 excerpt and draft a 2-paragraph control summary (auth, encryption, logging). Will include audit date and auditor.
Amit (Security): Ill draft the pentest attestation + exec summary (date, scope, top findings, remediation status) and a short staging-scan policy (48h notice, 3h window). Note: we do not share raw reports without NDA.
Clara (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. Please don't include operational guarantees; route any redlines to Legal. Small wording tweaks I can review same day.
ArtifactBot: Ticket POC-55221 created: "Cardinal POC assurance packet" assigned to Amit, Noah. Due: 2026-02-02.
Noah (SE): Pricing note: Hosted = no reservation (pay-as-you-go); Dedicated = short reserved slot (2-week typical) + onboarding fee. I'll add a one-row estimate for low/med/high usage.
Amit (Security): Ill post draft attestation by 10:00 PT tomorrow and include signer instructions for Legal.
Noah (SE): SOC2 excerpt + pricing table ETA: 15:00 PT tomorrow.
Tara (AE): Great — target single ZIP upload by 16:00 PT tomorrow. Ill confirm dataroom access and NDA. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
